newsitem.title: USA: Digital's AltaVista adds new search feature.
newsitem.headline: Digital's AltaVista adds new search feature.

text.p: Digital Equipment Corp's AltaVista Internet Software unit said it added a feature to its AltaVista Search service on the World Wide Web that lets users categorize the results from an AltaVista Web search.
The feature, "LiveTopics," organizes Web pages with similar content into groups of topics, making it much easier to find useful information quickly, Digital said.
AltaVista's search service gets more than 27 million hits per day on the Internet, according to Digital.
